rules: A crosses n+1 copies of `01` (rightwards): `A> (01)^n+1` becomes `1 (01)^n 0 E>`.
A crosses n+1 copies of `011` (rightwards): `A> (011)^n+1` becomes `1 0 (010)^n 0 E>`.
B crosses n+1 copies of `10` (rightwards): `B> (10)^n+1` becomes `(01)^n+1 B>`.
B crosses n+1 copies of `11` (rightwards): `B> (11)^n+1` becomes `0 0 (00)^n E>`.
B crosses n+1 copies of `110` (rightwards): `B> (110)^n+1` becomes `(001)^n+1 B>`.
E crosses n+1 copies of `10` (rightwards): `E> (10)^n+1` becomes `0 1 (01)^n B>`.
E crosses n+1 copies of `11` (rightwards): `E> (11)^n+1` becomes `(00)^n+1 E>`.
E crosses n+1 copies of `110` (rightwards): `E> (110)^n+1` becomes `0 0 1 (001)^n B>`.
